# Will your student loan ever be paid off, or written off first?

> Free UK student loan calculator for Plan 1, 2, 4, 5 and Postgraduate loans: monthly deduction, when you clear it, how much is written off, and whether overpaying is worth it. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/uk-student-loan-repayment-calculator/)
